requirements.statement: While no LL function has been called after reset, the IWDG LL driver shall not write any IWDG register.
requirements.verification: target_robot_test passes when no writes to IWDG registers occur before any LL function call

requirements.statement: The IWDG LL driver shall ensure that only the named bits are modified when writing to IWDG_PR.PR.
requirements.verification: host_unit_test passes when writes to IWDG_PR.PR modify only the PR field

requirements.statement: The IWDG LL driver shall ensure that only the named bits are modified when writing to IWDG_RLR.RL.
requirements.verification: host_unit_test passes when writes to IWDG_RLR.RL modify only the RL field
